meta.name: BEAM -- Belief-based Evaluation for Artificial Memory

abilities.IE: Information Extraction — extract facts from plain-text memory
abilities.MR: Memory Retrieval — retrieve relevant memories given a query
abilities.TR: Temporal Reasoning — reason about when events occurred and their order
abilities.ABS: Abstractive Summarization / Abstention — summarize or refuse to answer when data insufficient
abilities.CR: Counterfactual Reasoning — reason about what would be true under changed conditions
abilities.KU: Knowledge Updating — correctly update beliefs when new information contradicts old
abilities.EO: Entity Ordering — order entities/events by time, priority, or logical sequence
abilities.IF: Inference — draw logical conclusions from multiple facts
abilities.PF: Property/Attribute Following — track which entity has which property as properties change over time
abilities.SUM: Summarization — produce concise summaries of belief states across multiple documents
